headline: Menphina's Medallion (D) led on both glyphs (6.91) and icon (7.54), and all six jurors picked its icon. Nothing reached the 8.0 ship bar, so nothing ships yet; D is the base for a short round 3 that fixes known row-size problems.
recommendation: Take D's icon forward with dimmer, flatter glints moved clear of the Installed checkmark, and one quiet detail on the crescent. For the glyphs, use D's medallion material with A's row-size legibility: thin hairline rims on resting states, a Ready whose road glints break out of an opened bezel, the Done and Completed meanings swapped, a crescent for Ready on another job, and a single-wisp Not checked. Then rerun the same blind test and metrics.

Ready's road breaks the circle, so it can be found by shape alone, even colour-blind
favourite glyph set of the veteran raider and colour-blind jurors

shared.problem: Done and Completed read backwards: a check means finished, a blank full moon means nothing (new player swapped them in every set)
shared.fix: Put the check on Completed; give Done this cycle a comes-back mark such as a short gilt arc along the waning half's dark edge, tested against a refresh-icon read

shared.problem: Completed reads as a coin or radio button
shared.fix: Brighter face with a pale edge band and a gilt check crossing the lower-right edge; no ring at row size

shared.problem: Not checked reads as a hamburger menu (two parallel bars)
shared.fix: One curved, tapered mist wisp at a slight angle, no ring, bright enough to survive daylight scenes

shared.problem: Locked out reads as a no-entry sign (diagonal band in A and C, slash in B)
shared.fix: Use D's cracked Dalamud, with a thicker, darker crack that works without colour

shared.problem: A half moon in a ring reads as a contrast toggle
shared.fix: Make Ready on another job a crescent with a larger crystal

next: Icon: lower the brightest glints to about 85% of the crescent's brightness
Icon: flatten and vary the glints into horizontal ripple streaks
Icon: shift moon and road slightly left, clear of the Installed checkmark
Icon: add one quiet detail to the crescent (faint earthshine or one facet line)
Glyphs: thin, darker pewter hairline rims on the seven resting states; full gilt bezel on Ready only

Swap meanings: check moves to Completed; Done this cycle gets a comes-back arc

Ready on another job: crescent with a larger crystal to separate it from Blocked
Not checked: single curved wisp, no ghost ring

Fold iron and oxidised pewter into pewter to meet the colour budget
Rerun the blind test and metrics on the revised set
